name: Encased
description: A shaft, cogwheel or belt hidden inside a casing block.

pages.title: Encased
pages.text:
**Encased** means a shaft, cogwheel or belt is hidden in a **casing**. Right-click it with Andesite or Brass Casing; it keeps working.\
\
Parts placed after encasing don't connect until you toggle the side with a wrench. Casings are also the base of many machines.
